title: Kissed Velvety Venezuelan Red Cabbage Stew
description: A comforting and flavorful stew featuring red cabbage, perfect for a sick day, with a velvety texture and a hint of mustard, following satvik-friendly and salt-bake principles.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, mix together the shredded red cabbage, chopped onion, chopped carrot, and chopped potato.
In a small pan, heat the olive oil over medium heat and add the mustard seeds, letting them sizzle for a few seconds.
Add the salt and black pepper to the pan and stir to combine.
Pour the oil and spice mixture over the cabbage mixture and toss to coat.
Transfer the mixture to a large baking dish and add the water.
Cover the dish with a lid or foil and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove the lid or foil and continue baking for an additional 20 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender.
Remove the dish from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
